cat.deleteConfirm: Delete the folder “{name}” and its subfolders? The PDFs stay in the library.
cat.hint: Folders are virtual: a PDF can be in several at once, and no file is moved.
doc.name: Name
doc.deleteConfirm: Remove “{name}” from Ottoteca? Other copies on your device are not touched.
doc.deleteMany: Remove {n} PDFs from Ottoteca? Other copies on your device are not touched.

codes.scanning: I'm looking for QR codes and booking codes…
codes.none: No codes found in this PDF.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.note: Your tickets and loyalty cards, always ready, even offline. With the buttons on each card you can add them to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.
wallet.empty: No codes yet. Add one with the button above, or open a ticket PDF and tap “Find codes”.
wallet.name: Pass name
wallet.brightness: Turn the brightness up to make scanning easier.
squash.title: Heavy PDF?
squash.text: This PDF weighs {size}. {app} can make it lighter, right on your device.
squash.how: Save a copy, open {app}, compress it, then add the light version here.
set.title: Settings
set.privacy: Everything stays on your device: no account, no server, no tracking.
set.clearConfirm: Delete all PDFs, categories and passes from Ottoteca? This can't be undone.
install.ios: Tap the Share button in Safari, then “Add to Home Screen”.
mascot.label: Otto the otter: tap him, hold for a hug, or stroke him for cuddles
cheer.1: You've got this! One page at a time.
cheer.5: Take a breath: you're doing great.
cheer.6: Today is a good day to finish something.
cheer.10: Little by little, everything falls into place.
cheer.11: You shine brighter than any screen.
ev.welcome: Hi! I'm Otto. I'll keep your PDFs cosy.
ev.empty: Give me a PDF, I'll take good care of it!
ev.import: Yay! Your PDF is safe with me.
ev.heavy: That one's heavy! Shall we squash it?
ev.code: Found them! The codes are ready.
ev.nocode: No codes here, but you're still awesome.
ev.installed: Now I live on your home screen!
folder.empty: This folder is empty: add PDFs or drag them here.
folder.noPdf: No PDFs found in that folder.
scan.hint: Choose the PDFs, even all of Download at once, or a folder: they stay where they are, Ottoteca doesn't copy them.
scan.android: On Android, Download can't be linked as a folder: choose its PDFs directly with “Choose PDFs”.
scan.noApi: This browser can't open the device's folders: choose the PDFs or a folder and Ottoteca keeps a copy.
scan.perm: Allow Ottoteca to read your linked folders again.
scan.missing: This PDF is no longer in its folder.
roots.title: Device folders
roots.unlinkConfirm: Unlink “{name}”? Its PDFs leave Ottoteca; the files stay on the device.
ev.scan: Wow, look at all these PDFs!
pick.title: Where are your PDFs?
pick.files: Pick one or more PDFs: they stay where they are, nothing is copied.
pick.filesAndroid: Opens Download. To take them all: press and hold a PDF, then ⋮ → Select all → Select.
pick.folderHint: For example Documents: Ottoteca finds every PDF inside, subfolders too, and checks again each time. Android doesn't allow the whole memory or Download.
pick.share: From any app you can also tap Share → Ottoteca.
kind.hint: Ottoteca recognises the type from the text. If it got it wrong, choose it here.
share.text: Ottoteca: your PDFs cosy and tidy, with Otto the otter!
share.copied: Link copied: paste it wherever you like!
find.ios: Choose “On My iPhone” or iCloud Drive: Ottoteca takes every PDF, subfolders too, and keeps a copy. Tap again to update.
find.android: Choose the phone's memory (the first folder): Ottoteca takes every PDF, subfolders too, and keeps a copy. Tap again to update.
gw.title: Add to Google Wallet
gw.step1: Save the image of the code on the phone.
gw.step3: Tap “Add to Wallet” → “Everything else” (or “Photo”) and choose the saved image: Google Wallet creates the pass with the QR code.
add.found: Found it! Check the details and save.
add.notFound: No code found in the image: try a sharper photo, or type the number.
add.bad: This code can't be drawn with that type: check the number or choose another type.
aw.title: Add to Apple Wallet
aw.step2: Open WalletWallet, a free service that signs passes for Apple Wallet.
aw.step3: Paste the code, choose “{f}”, give it a name and tap “Add to Apple Wallet”.
aw.privacy: Apple Wallet only accepts signed passes: to create one, the code and the name go to WalletWallet, outside Ottoteca.
